definition: Media content (images, audio, video, or text) that has been generated or significantly altered using AI, as opposed to being captured directly from the real world.
details: Synthetic media spans both benign creative applications and more concerning uses like deepfakes, and its rapid growth has driven increased interest in provenance tracking and content authentication standards.
story: Imagine an art restorer who can spot a single cracked tile in a vast mosaic. What your eyes do without thinking, the machine does one careful layer at a time. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. The model looks the way you look at a crowd and finds the one face you know. And that is Synthetic Media — giving a machine the gift of sight.
